installMethods.publisherPin: Publisher describes a hosted Streamable HTTP service (sign-in or bearer token) and a local npm stdio package; neither is an approved method.

dependencies: Apify account and API token (the local package's manifest marks the token as required)
privilegeClaims: Acts with the permissions of the connected Apify account or token; its full tool set can also create, change and delete Actors and stored data in that account
networkClaims: Hosted service at https://mcp.apify.com (informational only, not an authorised endpoint)
Actors may fetch third-party websites on your behalf and send Actor inputs to Apify

notes: Cost: Actor runs use paid compute and can incur variable charges. The README describes discovery calls (search-actors, fetch-actor-details) as free; running an Actor is not.
No sign-in, token, payment method or billing was authorised here. A token must never be placed in a URL, configuration file, log or test artifact.
Publisher states telemetry is on by default and can be switched off; the stdio transport also reports errors to Sentry unless telemetry is opted out.
The hosted server can differ from the open-source local stdio server: the publisher says some features exist only on the hosted one.

The repository is also an agent plugin with skills (search, exa-agent). A plugin or skill distribution is not the same thing as an installed MCP server.
